Spacecraft name TUBSAT-N1
Type Nanosatellite
Units or mass 3 kg
Status Reentry 2000-10-20. Was operational until 1999-XX-XX. About 1 year operation.
Launched 1998-07-07
NORAD ID 25390
Deployer Custom
Launcher Shtil
Organisation Technical University of Berlin
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Nation Germany
Launch brokerer Unknown
Partners DLR (German Aerospace Centre)
Oneliner

Store and forward communication.
Description

Demonstration of low-cost access to space without performance reduction. Bidirectional data transfer between autonomous stations and the satellite. Tracking of medium-sized and large mammals. The main payload are two communication transceivers for store and forward communication with a baud-rate of 1200 and 2400 baud.
